name: ShopSmart retention schedule
source: ShopSmart Customer Data Inventory, 15 Oct 2026 (section 11) and DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 8

rules.name: Erase customer data after an erasure request
rules.basis: The customer asked for erasure. The demo uses RETENTION_ERASE_AFTER_SECONDS = 120 seconds; set a real period for production. Orders and payments are kept as tax records.

rules.name: Session tokens
rules.basis: A session token has no use once it expires (sessions last 7 days, REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS).

rules.name: Notifications
rules.basis: Open item in the data inventory: notifications are kept after erasure and have no retention period yet. Review them at 180 days until the team decides one.

rules.name: NigraniAI activity logs
rules.basis: Open item in the data inventory: set a deletion schedule for logs in the NigraniAI project. Must stay above the 1-year legal minimum (L3).

rules.name: Orders
rules.basis: Tax records: the CGST Act requires accounts to be kept for 72 months from the annual-return due date, about 7 to 8 years after the order.
rules.ref: CGST Act 2017 · s.36 (retention required by law, DPDP Act s.8(7))

rules.name: Payments
rules.basis: Tax and reconciliation records, kept on the same basis as orders.
rules.ref: CGST Act 2017 · s.36 (retention required by law, DPDP Act s.8(7))

rules.name: NigraniAI activity logs
rules.basis: Personal data, traffic data and logs of processing must be kept for at least one year.

rules.name: Inactive customer accounts
rules.basis: Erase after 3 years without a sign-in or order, warning the customer 48 hours before. Mandatory for e-commerce platforms with 2 crore+ registered users; applied here as good practice.
